results.description:
One of the filthiest short stories you'll read this year!

Andrea loves her husband, Kyle, and she wants to be the best partner she can be. But when she pushes the boundaries one too many times, Kyle goes to extreme lengths to instill some discipline in her. If that means bringing some of his friends home to help out, then so be it.

Punishing Her is the first book of Bound and Taken series, introducing readers to the exciting life of two lovers who love torture as much as they crave pleasure.

Author's Note: Each book in this series is a STAND-ALONE and can be read in any order. No cliffy, no cheating. Just Loads of swoons, sparks and bedroom steam just for you!
